so_what: Unbeaten nDabb loses Nacua, the format's biggest target sink, until Week 15 at the earliest, though McBride's volume holds with Wilson gone.
JayJBurn loses Stevenson, and his replacement Corey Kiner has no targets, so the New England vacancy is worth less in full PPR than elsewhere.
In a 14-team pool target-earning risers like Tre' Harris and Darius Cooper should clear fast, and every team still has its full budget.
hayhof (2-7) loses Jacobs and sees Jefferson capped by Minnesota's QB play, which makes it the likeliest seller of a star receiver.
kickkathsass loses Wilson and Evans but gains Rice, and kimberosburn's Hockenson is capped until Minnesota names a quarterback.
DrGMoney is stuck with Henderson and Ferguson out but gains Bijan volume, while kathrynemurray gets Skattebo back and a Lamb target bump.
